// buildCommand: There is no build step — @vercel/node compiles api/*.ts itself. An explicit no-op is used rather than leaving this blank, because the default would run the root `build` script, and a recursive workspace build that produces no output is an easy way to fail a deploy for no reason.
buildCommand: echo 'no build step: api/*.ts is compiled by @vercel/node'
// outputDirectory: Must exist or Vercel fails with 'No Output Directory found'. public/ holds a small status page so / is meaningful instead of a bare 404.
// rewrites: No entry for /api/* — filesystem routing already serves those functions directly, and an identity rewrite there is at best a no-op and at worst a loop.
